👉Level Up Your Data Engineering Interview Prep

👉Breaking into Data Engineering or working with Azure technologies?

👉This resource can help you strengthen your preparation.

👉Over the past 3 years, while working with Azure Data Factory, ADLS, and Databricks, Here is the gathered and organized 100 interview-oriented questions designed around practical industry scenarios.

👉Inside the PDF, you'll find:

👉Fundamental ADF concepts

👉Pipeline design and real-time use cases

👉Frequently asked interview challenges

✓ Important implementation best practices

👉The focus is not just on definitions - it's built around real project exposure and interview experiences.

👉The complete PDF is attached for easy access and learning.

Suggested approach:

👉Pause before checking the answers and try solving each question yourself first.

*please Follow Bindhu Gadi for more insights.

comment: Interview prep is strongest when it reflects production realities—handling failures, monitoring pipelines, cost optimization, and security patterns often separates theory from real Azure data engineering work.
